scenario.description: On a community theatre set, two friends prepare for an emotional scene, with one struggling to evoke the necessary tears.

agent_a.name: Oliver

profile.personality_and_values: Oliver Thompson is meticulous and outgoing with a penchant for analytical decision-making. He values adherence to social standards.
profile.public_info: Oliver enjoys painting in his free time as a way to express his creativity and relax after a stressful workday.

agent_a.goal: Get your co-actor to cry in the scene (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been acting for several years and have good control over your emotions. You can cry on cue.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Oliver wants Ethan to cry on cue because he values adherence to social standards and wants the scene to meet professional expectations.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Smith is a reserved, independent thinker. Holding universalism and fairness near, he ponders deeply before making decisions.
profile.public_info: Ethan enjoys reading about new technological advancements and watching documentaries.

agent_b.goal: Try to cry in the scene but keep your composure (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a new actor and have difficulty crying on cue. You are worried that your lack of tears will ruin the scene.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan wants to cry in the scene so that he doesn't ruin it, as he values fairness and wants to contribute equally.
